use_daemon.description: Enable ifupdown2d daemon mode. Valid values: yes, no.

template_engine.description: Default template engine to use. Currently only mako is supported.

template_lookuppath.description: Directory path where templates are looked up during rendering.

default_interfaces_configfile.description: Path to the default network interfaces configuration file.

disable_cli_interfacesfile.description: Disable the -i interfacefile CLI option to reduce security issues. Valid values: 0, 1.

addon_syntax_check.description: Enable Python addon module syntax checking. Valid values: 0, 1.

addon_scripts_support.description: Support executing of ifupdown style scripts. Valid values: 0, 1.

addon_python_modules_support.description: Enable python addons support. Valid values: 0, 1.

multiple_vlan_aware_bridge_support.description: Support multiple vlan filtering bridges. Valid values: 0, 1.

ifquery_check_success_str.description: String displayed for successful ifquery checks.

ifquery_check_error_str.description: String displayed for failed ifquery checks.

ifquery_check_unknown_str.description: String displayed for unknown ifquery check status.

ifquery_ifacename_expand_range.description: Control iface/vlan range expansions in ifquery default output. Valid values: 0, 1.

link_master_slave.description: Let link master (bridges, bonds) own the link state of slaves. Valid values: 0, 1.

delay_admin_state_change.description: Delay admin state change till the end. Valid values: 0, 1.

ifreload_down_changed.description: Down interfaces that were deleted only if 0, otherwise down changed interfaces too. Valid values: 0, 1.

addr_config_squash.description: Squash all addr config when processing the first interface. Valid values: 0, 1.

ifaceobj_squash.description: Squash iface config into one when having multiple iface stanzas. Valid values: 0, 1.

adjust_logical_dev_mtu.description: Adjust logical devices MTU based on physical interface. Valid values: 0, 1.

state_dir.description: Directory where the state file is stored.
